newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Bank of Cyprus in new factor service.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Cyprus in new factor service.

text.p: Bank of Cyprus Factors on Thursday launched Non-Recourse Factoring Services, a service which introduces trade credit insurance to factoring based on an assessment of insolvency risks.
The service can protect businesses from bad debts and lift business confidence and payment punctuality, the bank said.

"Cypriot businesses will be able to obtain information on the credit worthiness of current or new customers at home and abroad, and be insured against the risk of their insolvency," said Athos Kyranides, general manager of Bank of Cyprus Factors.
The cost of the service varies according to the solvency of the portfolio but in most cases it ranges from 0.50 percent to 0.75 percent over and above the administration commission charged.
